tasks.label: Terraform: Validate All
args: $directories = @('demos', 'modules', 'templates') | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -Path $_ -Directory }; foreach ($directory in $directories) { $directory.Name; terraform "-chdir=$($directory.FullName)" init -backend=false -input=false; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; terraform "-chdir=$($directory.FullName)" validate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }

tasks.label: Terraform: Init and Plan demo 01
args: terraform '-chdir=demos/01-compute-in-the-cloud' init -input=false; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; terraform '-chdir=demos/01-compute-in-the-cloud' plan -input=false; exit $LASTEXITCODE
